$comment: What doberman knows about this template: how to recognize it, its gates, its risk areas. scripts/doberman.mjs reads it; keep it in step with package.json, .github/workflows/quality-gates.yml and docs/testing.md.

typecheck.name: Typecheck (contract drift, typed routes, the tooling scripts)

test:coverage.name: Tests (app: unit, component, integration, accessibility; API: unit, OpenAPI drift spec) + coverage thresholds

security.name: Security (audit, dependency policy, secrets in the tree)

build.name: Build (the API, and the app's export: Hermes bytecode for Android and iOS)

extraGates.name: Repository script tests (Doberman engine, Semgrep file selection, mock API against the contract)
Secrets in the git history (gitleaks)
extraGates.commandWindows: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 docker run --rm -v "$(cygpath -w "$PWD"):/repo:ro" "$(node scripts/tool-image.mjs gitleaks)" git /repo --redact --no-banner

extraGates.name: Integration tests (API + PostgreSQL + Redis + Mailpit)
extraGates.note: Runs on <db>_test, never the development database. The Redis adapter specs and the outbox specs run against the development Redis and Mailpit (REDIS_URL and MAIL_SMTP_URL of apps/api/.env, or REDIS_TEST_URL and MAIL_TEST_SMTP_URL), each under its own key prefix or mailbox; required in CI, skipped locally without a URL: say so.

extraGates.name: Container images (build + Trivy scan)
extraGates.command: per .github/workflows/docker-images.yml: docker build of apps/api/Dockerfile (targets runtime and migrate), tagged doberman-scan/<image>, then the Trivy scan of each with `node scripts/tool-image.mjs trivy` and the workflow's flags; remove the doberman-scan images afterwards

extraGates.name: Native projects (expo prebuild, Android + iOS)
extraGates.command: pnpm --filter mobile exec expo prebuild --no-install --platform all
extraGates.note: Writes apps/mobile/android/ and apps/mobile/ios/: run it in the sandbox, never in the workspace (`pnpm prebuild` is `--clean`).

extraGates.name: Android release build + Maestro flows
extraGates.command: docs/testing.md#end-to-end: release APK of the e2e variant, `pnpm mock:api`, `pnpm test:e2e:mobile`
extraGates.note: On Windows the native build needs a short path (DOBERMAN_TMP=C:\dbm) and a hoisted node_modules (docs/testing.md#end-to-end).

extraGates.name: iOS build + simulator flows
extraGates.command: macOS only: `pnpm ios` (development build) or the release build of docs/testing.md, then `pnpm test:e2e:mobile` on the simulator

areas.focus: mobile sessions with tokens in the body: refresh rotation with family revocation, the 30 s reuse window and superseded successors, the user row lock, sign-in timing, password hashing, token claims and securityVersion
@Auth(...) on every non-public route, roles, ownership in the query (another user's id → 404), no IDOR
Zod DTOs with bounds and named fields in errors[], explicit select, pagination limits, error paths, transactions and locks, idempotency keys, account deletion cascades
committed migration, never an edited one, expand/contract safety while the previous version runs, indexes for new queries, no unbounded queries, no $queryRawUnsafe
process.env read only in env.ts, schema + .env.example + docs together, optional integrations off by default and never stopping the boot

CacheService/LockService/IdempotencyService only, degradation when Redis is absent, readiness probe, the outbox, external calls through createExternalHttpClient (timeouts, SSRF), the minimum app version gate
rate limits per account or signed-in user behind carrier NAT, with IP ceilings; Fetch Metadata guard, CORS, security and cache headers; the images: pinned bases, non-root, no package managers
one renewal at a time, generation guard against late renewals, refresh token rotation, restore offline, sign-out cleanup
timeout and abort forwarding, one replay after 401, AppError mapping, breadcrumbs without query strings or bodies

regenerated by pnpm contract, backwards compatibility with installed app versions (additive changes, the minimum version for anything else), status codes, envelope and errors[], named schemas, mock API and fixtures in step
query keys, cancellation (signal), invalidation, optimistic updates and rollback, no retried mutations, nothing copied to Zustand
loading/empty/error/offline states, double submit, unmount during requests, thin routes, Stack.Protected guards, AlertText, a11y spec
untrusted input: allowlist, parameter validation, no action performed by a link
secure vs persistent storage, data inventory, cleared at sign-out, stored data from the previous version still loads
EXPO_PUBLIC_* is public, permissions and usage texts, OTA vs store build, runtimeVersion, store compliance
justified, SDK-compatible (expo install), supply-chain settings never weakened, no new install scripts

redaction: no tokens, passwords or personal data in logs, breadcrumbs, reports or events; API: redaction, ids not personal data, errorTracker once, low-cardinality metric attributes, observability/api-metrics.json in step with the code
roles and accessible names, 48 dp targets, theme tokens only, announcements
no gate, threshold, rule or permission weakened; workflows least privilege, pinned, no PR path to releases
would the tests fail if the code were wrong: realistic stubs, failure paths, races, no snapshots
English and Spanish manuals and step-by-step guides changed together; commands and anchors still exist

reproduction.fileSuffix: .doberman.spec.tsx (or .doberman.spec.ts) for the app; .doberman.spec.ts for API units, .doberman.int.spec.ts for API integration
reproduction.location: next to the code under test: inside apps/mobile/src/ (jest only collects apps/mobile/src/**/*.spec.ts(x)) or apps/api/src/ (each runner only collects its app's src/)
reproduction.runOne: app: pnpm --filter mobile exec jest --coverage=false --runTestsByPath <path from apps/mobile> · API unit: pnpm --filter api exec vitest run <path from apps/api> · API integration (database): pnpm --filter api exec vitest run --config vitest.config.int.ts <path from apps/api>
